),

CitySimilarity AS (
    SELECT c.id AS city_id, c.city_name, distance(c.city_description_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
        FROM city c
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 5
)

FROM GamesInYear gsy
JOIN CitySimilarity ci ON toString(gsy.city_id) = toString(ci.city_id)

question: Could you identify and list the names of 10 games most related to winter sports events and the names of 10 cities most related to European capitals, then show me the paired game and city names sorted by how closely they match these topics?

    lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', 'European capitals') AS ref_vec_1,

games_filtered AS (

        *,
        distance(games_description_embedding, ref_vec_0) AS distance
    FROM games

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 10
),

city_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        distance(city_description_embedding, ref_vec_1) AS distance
    FROM city

    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 10
),

similar_games AS (
    SELECT id, games_name, distance
        FROM games_filtered AS games
),

        FROM city_filtered AS city
)

SELECT g.games_name, c.city_name
FROM similar_games g

ORDER BY g.distance, c.distance
